book.name: SVUN LUCAS
book.title: LI'I JA' SC'OPLAL CAJVALTIC JESUCRISTO TS'IBABIL COMEL YU'UN LUCAS

content: Ja' smelol c'alal icol jun vinic Zaqueo sbi
Li sbelal Jerusalene tey xjelov batel ta yut lum Jericó, jech tey xa ijelov batel li Jesuse.
Oy jun vinic tey ta lum Jericó, Zaqueo sbi. Tsots yabtel yich'oj. Ja' banquilal yu'un jtsobpatanetic, ja' ta xich' li taq'uine ja' chbat yac'be li boch'o sventainoje. Jech jc'ulej o.
Li Zaqueoe tsc'an ta sq'uel c'u x'elan li Jesuse. Tsc'an ta xotquin. Pero muc xil yu'un toj ep li cristianoetique. Yu'un comcom li Zaqueoe.
Jech ijelov ta anil. Imuy ta jpets igo ta nopol ti' be yo' bu ta xjelov li Jesuse yu'un jech xu' ta xil ti c'alal ta xjelove.
C'alal ic'ot ta igo li Jesuse, la sq'uel muyel. Laj yil tey luchul li vinique, jech laj yalbe: ―Zaqueo, yalan tal ta ora yu'un tsots sc'oplal tey chibat ta ana ―xut.
Jech ta ora iyal li Zaqueoe. Xcuxet no'ox yo'nton laj yic' batel ta sna li Jesuse.

C'alal laj yil cristianoetic ti ibat ta sna Zaqueo li Jesuse, chopol laj ya'yic. Jech tey iliquic ta vochlajetel scotolic yu'un sna'ojic ti ja' jlo'lavanej li Zaqueoe. Laj yalic ti bat xchi'in jpasmulil li Jesuse.

Li Zaqueoe iva'i, jech laj yalbe li Cajvaltique: ―Cajval, ta xcac'be j'o'loluc c'usitic oy cu'un li me'onetique. Me oy boch'o la jlo'labe staq'uine, más ech'em ta jsutes. Me la jlo'la ciene, chanib ciento chcac'be ―xi.
Li Jesuse jech laj yal: ―Li' ta orae lacol xa acotolic ta sjunul ana. Co'ol xa avo'nton achi'uc li jmoltotic Abraám ta vo'onee yu'un laj ach'un ti vu'un Jcoltavanejun avu'une.
Vu'un ti co'ol cristianoutique tal jsa' li boch'otic ch'ayemique yu'un tal jcolta ―xi li Jesuse.
Ja' lo'il sventa lajuneb mozoetic ti i'ac'bat sjolintasic jujusep staq'uin yajvalique

C'alal tey ta xa'yic c'usi ta xal Jesús li cristianoetique, li Jesuse laj yal jun lo'il yu'un po'ot xa chc'otic ta Jerusalén. Ja' la sloc'tabe ta lo'il ti muc to ja'uc yorail ta x'och ta ajvalilale. Yu'un la snop israeletic ti ja' xa ta x'och ta ajvalilal yu'unic tey ta Jerusalene, ja' li boch'o t'ujbil yu'un Diose.

Li Jesuse jech laj yal: ―Oy jun xnich'on muc'ta ajvalil. Lec jc'ulej li xnich'one. Ibat ta nom ta yan banamil. Yu'un bat yich' tal yabtel yu'un ta x'och ta ajvalilal, yu'un ja' chlic sventain scotol li xchi'iltaque. Ts'acal to ta sut tal.

C'alal mu'yuc to'ox chbate, laj yic' tal lajuneb smozo. Ta jujuntal laj yac'anbe jujusep saquil taq'uin ep ta cien snitoj sba jujusep. Jech laj yalbe: “Bat jolintasic. C'alal me lisut tal ta yan c'ac'ale, ja' to ta xvul quich'”, xut comel.

Li cristianoetique chopol laj ya'yic ti ja' ta x'och ta ajvalilal jun xchi'ilique. Jech lic staquic batel boch'o chbat yal ti bu batem yich' tal yabtele. Jech c'ot yalic: “Mu jc'ancutic ti ja' ta x'och ta ajvalilal cu'uncutic li jchi'ilcutic le'e”, xiic c'otel.
C'alal laj yich' yabtel sventa ajvalil li vinique, isut tal. C'alal ic'ote, la stacan ta iq'uel li smozotac ti yac'ojbe sjolintas staq'uine, yu'un tsc'an ta xa'i c'u yepal ijolin yu'un jujunic.
Li boch'o ba'yuc itale jech laj yal: “Cajval, lajuneb ijolin cu'un li ataq'uin laj avac'bun comele”, xut vulel li yajvale.
Itac'ov li yajvale: “Lec oy, vo'ote lequil mozoot. Yu'un jun avo'nton laj ajolintas li jtaq'uine, jech chacac'bot aventain lajuneb lum”, x'utat.
Ital noxtoc li yane, jech laj yal: “Cajval, vo'ob ijolin cu'un li ataq'uin laj avac'bun comele”, xut vulel li yajvale.
Itac'ov li yajvale: “Vo'ote vo'ob lum chacac'bot aventain”, xut.
Ital noxtoc li yane, jech laj yal: “Cajval, ilo li jsep ataq'uin laj avac'bune. Lec la jpix ta panyo, lec la jnac'.
Yu'un lixi' avu'un. Jna'oj ti toj cimarronote. La jna' ti chavich' sutel xchi'uc sjol li ataq'uine, chavich' ti bu mu ja'uc avabtele”, xi la spoj sba.

Jech i'albat yu'un li yajvale: “Vo'ote ch'ajil mozoot. Mu junuc avo'nton ta jtojol jech mu xac'an xa'abtej. Ta jchapan li c'usi laj avale. Me laj ana' ti toj cimarronun ta sventa ti ta xquich' ti bu mu ja'uc cabtel chavale, ¿c'u yu'un muc xbat atic' ta banco yu'un ac'o sjolintas li yajval bancoe? C'alal lisut tale, laj quich' sutel xchi'uc sjol ti jechuque”, xut.
Jech laj yalbe li yantic tey oyique: “Pojbeic li jsep jtaq'uin yich'oje, ja' ac'beic li boch'o laj yich' tal lajunebe”, xut.
Jech laj yalic: “¡Cajval, pero yich'oj xa lajunsep!” xutic.

Itac'ov li ajvalile: “Chacalboxuc, scotol li boch'o ta x'abtejic cu'une ta sta c'usi oy yu'unic. Jech más to ta xcac'be yan noxtoc. Yan li boch'otic mu sc'an x'abtejic cu'une mu'yuc c'usi ta staic o. Ta jpojbe noxtoc li c'usitic cac'ojbeique.
Jech noxtoc li boch'otic ta scontrainicune, ti mu sc'anic vu'un ta jventaine, iq'uic tal scotol li'i. Li' ta jsat xamilic”, xi li ajvalile ―xi li Jesuse.
Ja' smelol ti ich'bil ta muc' i'och ta Jerusalén li Jesuse
C'alal laj yal jech lo'il li Jesuse, ijelov batel ta ba'yucbe yu'un chbat ta Jerusalén xchi'uc yajchanc'optac.
Tey ic'otic ta nopol tsobtsobnaetic Betfagé xchi'uc ta lum Betánia tey ta yoc vits Olivatic. Li Jesuse la stac batel chib yajchanc'op.
Jech laj yalbe: ―Batanic ta tsobtsobnaetic le'e. C'alal cha'ochique, tey chucbil chataic jcot burro mu'yuc to cajlebinbil. Titunic, iq'uic tal.
Me oy boch'o ta sjac'boxuc ti c'u yu'un chatitunic li burroe, jech xavalbeic: “Yu'un ta xtun yu'un li Cajvaltique”, utic ―xi li Jesuse.
Ibatic li chibique. Ti c'u x'elan i'albatic batel yu'un Cajvaltique ja' jech la staic.
C'alal ja' o tey tstitunic li burroe, jech i'albatic yu'un li yajvale: ―¿C'u yu'un chatitunic li jburroe? ―x'utatic.
Itac'ovic: ―Yu'un ta xtun yu'un li Cajvaltique ―xutic.
Jech laj yiq'uic batel bu oy li Jesuse. Laj yac'beic staspatin slapbolal xaquitaic, jech tey icaji li Jesuse.
C'alal cajal xa batel ta burro li Jesuse, li israeletique la sq'uiic slapbolal xaquitaic ta be.

C'alal nopol xa x'ech'ic batel ta yeloval Jerusalén yo' bu vits Olivatique, tsots lic avanicuc scotol li boch'otic scotol c'ac'al la xchi'inic Jesuse. Xcuxet no'ox yo'ntonic laj yalbeic slequilal Dios ta sventa ti laj yilic ep sq'uelubil stsatsal la spas li Jesuse.
Jech laj yalic: ―¡Toj lec li ajvalil la stacbutic tal Cajvaltic Diose! ¡Lec xa chijyilutic li Diose! ¡Ac'o ich'atuc ta muc'! ―xi ch‑avanic.
Oy jayibuc fariseoetic tey xchi'uquic. Jech laj yalbeic li Jesuse: ―Jchanubtasvanej, pajeso li jch'unolajeletic avu'une yu'un loq'uel ch‑avanic ―xutic.
Li Jesuse jech laj yalbe: ―Chacalboxuc, me ta xch'abiic li jch'unolajeletic cu'une, ja' ta xlic avanicuc li tonetique ―xut.
C'alal ta xa xc'ot ta Jerusalén li Jesuse, la sq'uel li lume, laj yoc'ta li xchi'iltac tey nacajtique.
Jech laj yal: ―Ana'icuc ti yorail xa chacolique, lec, pero mu xana'ic.
Yu'un ta to sta sc'ac'alil ta xtal set sbaic li' ta lum li avajcontraique, ta smacoxuc ta jujujot.

Ta svuq'uesic li lum avu'unique. Me jbejuc ton mu'yuc bu cajal ta xcom ta sba yac'ol yan ton, scotol ta svuq'uesic. Ta smiloxuc acotolic noxtoc. Ja' ta scoj ti mu xach'unic ti vu'un tacbilun tal yu'un Dios chajcoltaoxuque ―xi li Jesuse.
Ja' smelol c'alal la sloq'ues jbolomaletic ta yamaq'uil templo li Jesuse
Li Jesuse i'och ta yamaq'uil templo tey ta Jerusalén. La sloq'ues scotol li jbolomaletic tey oyique.
Jech laj yalbe: ―Jech ts'ibabil ta sc'op Dios: “Li jnae ja' snail bu chac'opanicun”, xi yaloj li Diose. Li vo'oxuque apasojic xa ta snailch'en j'eleq'uetic ―xi.

Li Jesuse scotol c'ac'al tey ichanubtasvan ta yamaq'uil templo ta Jerusalén. Li banquilal paleetique xchi'uc li jchanubtasvanejetic ta smantal Dios yalojique, xchi'uc li jchapanvanejetique, la snopilanic c'u x'elan xu' ta smilic li Jesuse.
Pero muc staic, yu'un scotol cristianoetic jun yo'nton laj ya'ibeic sc'op li Jesuse.
